tools.name: nastech_compile_speech
tools.description: Compile English NastechML into a validated Fish S2 expressive-speech payload. Use this to inspect real emotion/event controls before synthesis.

markup.description: English NastechML. Example: <speak><emotion name="sad">I miss home.</emotion><sound type="sigh" /></speak>

reference_id.description: Optional Fish reference voice ID or speaker ID array.

tools.name: nastech_generate_speech
tools.description: Generate English expressive speech from NastechML using the configured Fish S2 local server or Fish Audio cloud provider.

http.response: audio bytes with X-Nastech-Request-Id and X-Nastech-Provider headers
